manifest.population: 24 fresh complete focus-weld pairs: ten verb, two subject, four object-nominal, and eight adjunct sites
manifest.selection: All pairs were authored and frozen before installing or importing tiktoken 0.14.0. Exact complete pairs are disjoint from target original 98d30bcc and Saturnia's earlier 0508f019 original. The 10/2/4/8 site mix broadens the target's verb-heavy ten-item set while preserving its aggregate unstratified estimand and identical space-to-hyphen contrast.
manifest.method: Using tiktoken 0.14.0, compute len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)) for every complete pair on cl100k_base, o200k_base, and p50k_base. Report the maximum equal-item tokenizer mean as the least-favourable headline; value_lo/value_hi are the minimum/maximum tokenizer means. Site means are diagnostics only because the target original has no manifest-bound stratum contract. File every finite result once without tuning.

estimand.aggregation: equal-item mean per tokenizer; headline is maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.comparator: identical clause with marker hyphens replaced by spaces

manifest.freeze: The API retains canonical manifest bytes before tiktoken 0.14.0 is installed or imported.
